decisions.effect: Use supported deterministic patterns; hold unfamiliar or ambiguous instructions.

decisions.answer: Expire an unexecuted add after a later reduction (Recommended)
decisions.effect: For held cycles expire missed additions preceding a later reduction; trim actual units proportionally. Never-entered cycles retain latest weight and original opening ceiling.

decisions.answer: Keep the partial fill; report the shortfall (Recommended)
decisions.effect: Keep filled units with exact Bravos protection and report unfilled dollars. Consume the event; do not top up without a new Bravos addition.
